svg.title: vanking.uz — good ideas later
svg.desc: The original sleepy brown mascot in round green glasses and a green hoodie, holding a cream coffee mug in one raised paw. The other arm rests by its side. The mug reads GOOD IDEAS LATER. Above the mascot, a handwritten Russian caption reads Работаем, чтобы вы развивались, with a green heart and arrow. All artwork and lettering are vector paths.
